recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future editorial work may align shorter Bundle/value-set descriptions with the Search page, but FHIR-34042 itself is already satisfied and does not require a source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-34042 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification request asking the specification to be explicit that a server may add referenced resources to a searchset Bundle with entry.search.mode=include even when the client did not use the _include parameter.
initial_application: No FHIR-34042-tagged source commit was found, and the combined branch did not already contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit for this issue. The relevant wording appears to have been applied by commit 36e9fd596f19b74d5c8d764b14cf9faa96d943d7, which added the Search Responses section and the include-mode paragraph to source/search.html before the final FHIR-I vote and R5 publication.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion confirms that the behavior was viewed as already allowed but worth documenting because of brittle-client concerns. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-03-07 record FHIR-34042 as Persuasive by a 9-0-0 motion. The current HTTP search section delegates search processing to the Search page, where the clarification now appears.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/search.html already states the requested behavior in the relevant Search Responses section.
